name: testit-mcp-server
description: Test IT test management for AI assistants: work items, test plans, test runs and results.
long_description: Connects Claude, Cursor and other MCP clients to a Test IT instance through its v2 API. The assistant can search and edit work items, sections and shared steps, plan and run tests, read results and analytics. Read-only mode and toolset filtering keep it safe and the tool list short.

testit_url.title: Test IT URL
testit_url.description: Base URL of your Test IT instance, e.g. https://testit.example.com

testit_token.title: API token
testit_token.description: Private API token from your Test IT profile

project_id.title: Default project UUID
project_id.description: Optional. Used when a request does not name a project

toolsets.title: Toolsets
toolsets.description: Optional comma-separated toolsets, e.g. default,admin. Empty = default
